chunks: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah narrated to us from al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq al-Nahdi from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from 'Abdullah ibn Ghalib from Sa'd al-Iskaf from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him). He said:

When any believer washes a [deceased] believer and says when he turns him over: "O Allah, this is the body of Your believing servant. You have removed his spirit from it and have separated between the two. So, Your forgiveness, Your forgiveness," Allah will forgive his sins of a year, except the major sins.

key_terms.غسل: ghusl - the ritual washing of the deceased

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited while washing a deceased believer in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) teaches the supplication to recite while performing the funeral bath (ghusl al-mayyit) for a deceased believer. The washer is instructed to say a prayer acknowledging that Allah has taken the soul from the body and to plead for divine forgiveness. The reward for this act is the forgiveness of one year of minor sins, reflecting the high spiritual merit of caring for the deceased in Islam.
